CustomObject.description: One committee member's attendance at one committee meeting. A junction: master-detail to both the meeting and the committee assignment, so deleting either side cleans up after itself and both can roll up a count. Mirrors Board Meeting Attendance, but keyed to Committee Assignment rather than Board Membership Year, because committee members are not necessarily board members. JSI-123 Board Tracking. Author: Jason Ott.
CustomObject.label: Committee Meeting Attendance
